personalInfo.professionalTitle: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / Kafka Administrator

bullets: 9+ years of relevant professional experience across Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Kafka platform engineering, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, software engineering, production support, automation, and enterprise application delivery.

Strong hands-on experience administering and supporting enterprise Apache Kafka, Confluent Platform, and Confluent Cloud environments, including brokers, topics, partitions, replicas, producers, consumers, consumer groups, offsets, replication, retention, schemas, ACLs, RBAC, and platform governance.

Extensive experience designing, operating, monitoring, and troubleshooting highly available event-driven architectures and distributed systems with emphasis on scalability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, performance, capacity planning, and production reliability.

Hands-on experience with Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, Cluster Linking, MirrorMaker, topic mirroring, replication, consumer lag monitoring, partitioning strategies, and Kafka performance tuning supporting high-throughput, low-latency enterprise workloads.

Strong experience applying Site Reliability Engineering practices involving SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, availability, latency, throughput, incident management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), production support, on-call operations, MTTR improvement, monitoring, alerting, and operational automation.

Experience deploying and operating cloud-native workloads using Microsoft Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux/Unix, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code practices to support highly available and scalable production platforms.
Strong experience with Java 8/11/17, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, Python, SQL, asynchronous processing, concurrency, distributed systems, and event-driven application architectures.

Hands-on experience developing operational automation using Python and Shell scripting for Kafka administration, platform provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, log analysis, deployment support, and production troubleshooting.

Experience implementing observability using Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch, Splunk, logging, metrics, dashboards, and alerting to monitor application health, infrastructure utilization, Kafka consumer lag, throughput, latency, and service availability.
Strong understanding of Linux/Unix, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, networking, load balancing, authentication, authorization, SSL/TLS, encryption, ACLs, RBAC, and production troubleshooting.

Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Maven, Gradle, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes to support repeatable application and infrastructure deployments.

Strong production-support background involving 24x7 on-call support, incident response, troubleshooting, service restoration, root-cause analysis, post-incident corrective actions, runbooks, disaster-recovery procedures, and operational readiness.
Experienced in relational database technologies including PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, SQL, data modeling, query optimization, indexing, transaction management, and ETL processing.

Proven ability to collaborate with application development, DevOps, infrastructure, security, database, architecture, QA, and product teams while establishing Kafka governance, operational standards, monitoring practices, production readiness, and platform reliability.

experience.role: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / Kafka Administrator
experience.description: ISBUS is AT&T's enterprise-wide Kafka platform for real-time data streaming and messaging, providing high-throughput, low-latency event delivery for enterprise applications. The platform is deployed on Azure Cloud for high availability, security, and compliance, with Python as the primary language for automation and platform tooling and Azure services for infrastructure management.
responsibilities: Administered and optimized enterprise Apache Kafka, Confluent Platform, and Confluent Cloud environments, supporting highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant real-time messaging for business-critical enterprise applications.

Designed, deployed, and supported Kafka platform components on Microsoft Azure and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), integrating Azure networking and Private Endpoints to provide secure and reliable platform connectivity.

Managed Kafka topics, partitions, replication factors, retention policies, producers, consumers, consumer groups, offsets, quotas, and partitioning strategies, balancing throughput, latency, availability, and data durability requirements.

Implemented and maintained Schema Registry practices to establish consistent event contracts and data formats across producers and consumers while supporting reliable integration between distributed applications.
Implemented Confluent Cluster Linking across Kafka environments to support reliable cross-cluster replication, platform availability, workload migration, and disaster-recovery requirements.
Implemented cross-cluster replication and topic mirroring using Kafka MirrorMaker, strengthening regional disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and continuity for critical event-streaming workloads.

Automated Kafka administration activities including topic provisioning, configuration management, consumer management, ACL creation, monitoring, validation, and operational checks using Python, reducing repetitive manual platform work.
Automated ACL and RBAC provisioning in Confluent Cloud, improving standardized authentication, authorization, access governance, and operational consistency across application teams.

Configured and supported Kafka Connect integrations with Azure services, databases, and external systems, enabling reliable data movement and reusable integration patterns across enterprise workloads.

Built comprehensive observability, monitoring, dashboards, and alerting using Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Python, tracking broker health, consumer lag, throughput, latency, infrastructure utilization, and service availability.

Monitored and troubleshot Kafka brokers, partitions, replicas, consumer lag, rebalances, throughput, latency, message-processing failures, and data inconsistencies, performing Root Cause Analysis and implementing preventive reliability improvements.

Performed Kafka performance tuning and capacity planning, analyzing partition distribution, replication, producer and consumer configuration, resource utilization, network behavior, throughput, and workload growth to maintain stable platform performance.

Supported Kubernetes and AKS platform operations including deployments, scaling, resource utilization, health monitoring, rolling upgrades, configuration management, and production troubleshooting for Kafka-related workloads.

Planned and executed Kafka platform upgrades, configuration changes, patching, and production releases using Azure DevOps pipelines and automated deployment practices while minimizing service disruption.
Implemented and maintained high-availability, backup, recovery, failover, and disaster-recovery procedures using Azure capabilities and automated operational workflows to improve platform resilience.

Implemented Kafka and Azure security controls including encryption, authentication, authorization, ACLs, RBAC, secure connectivity, and access-management practices to support enterprise security and compliance requirements.
Developed and maintained ETL and data-processing workflows using Python, PostgreSQL, and Apache Airflow, creating dynamic DAGs for reliable workflow scheduling and platform-related data processing.

Administered ZooKeeper configurations supporting Kafka environments and developed Python and Paramiko automation for remote Linux server administration, configuration validation, troubleshooting, and operational maintenance.

Participated in production support and on-call operations, troubleshooting complex Kafka, Linux, networking, application, and infrastructure incidents using Kafka native utilities, Confluent Control Center, Confluent CLI, monitoring dashboards, metrics, and logs.

Performed incident response, service restoration, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and preventive improvements, maintaining operational runbooks and disaster-recovery procedures for recurring production scenarios.

Collaborated with application teams to onboard Kafka producers and consumers, establishing topic conventions, partitioning requirements, quotas, access policies, monitoring expectations, and production-readiness standards.

Worked with application, DevOps, infrastructure, security, database, and architecture teams to improve Kafka governance, platform reliability, scalability, observability, automation, and operational excellence.

Developed Python-based operational tooling and automation to reduce manual intervention across Kafka administration, monitoring, configuration validation, data processing, and platform-support activities.
Built and optimized responsive React.js interfaces used for platform tooling, applying reusable frontend development practices, memoization, and lazy loading to improve rendering performance.
Conducted knowledge-transfer and technical training sessions covering Kafka administration, Python automation, Azure cloud operations, troubleshooting, monitoring, and platform best practices.
